review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Ciklum is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team full-time in Czech Republic. We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. About The Role As a Senior DevOps Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Our client's infrastructure powers millions of live sports events worldwide - from raw video capture at remote venues to real-time stream delivery and ML-driven monetization. As a DevOps & Platform Engineer, you will be a core contributor to the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our cloud platform. You'll work inside a self-service, pod-based engineering model where your job is to build the platforms, pipelines, and guardrails that let product teams ship independently - at high velocity and with full operational ownership. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact individual contributor role with a clear technical growth path. Responsibilities Build and maintain GitOps-based delivery pipelines (ArgoCD) so product pods deploy safely without DevOps intervention Design and evolve self-service tooling - golden paths, deployment templates, scaffolding - that reduce pod dependency on the platform team Implement deployment safety guardrails: config diffing, change ownership, rollout strategies, and audit trails Adopt industry-leading AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, automation, and operational delivery Requirements 5+ years in infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering roles Production-grade Kubernetes experience: EKS/GKE, GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux), service mesh, multi-tenant cluster operations, resource management Deep hands-on GitOps and CI/CD: ArgoCD or Flux, Kustomize/Helm, rollout strategies, deployment safety, change ownership, audit trails AWS platform depth: EC2, EKS, S3, CloudFront, IAM/IRSA, VPC networking, RDS, cost optimization levers Platform engineering orientation - you think in platforms and self-service, not one-off scripts or manual runbooks AI-first approach - actively uses AI tools to accelerate development and operations; not just aware of them, but fluent Ownership mentality - own outcomes end-to-end, escalate only when truly blocked, and translate infrastructure complexity into business impact People leadership skills, including mentoring and developing engineers, as well as conducting technical interviews Desirable GCP experience (GKE, GCS, Cloud Run) or hybrid multi-cloud operations Video streaming infrastructure: HLS, RTMP, CDN optimization, live video pipelines FinOps / cost optimization: cost attribution, right-sizing, storage lifecycle policies Development background (Python, Go, Node.js, or similar) What’s in it for you? Flexible working hours Home office option 5 weeks of holiday 5 sick days Multisport Card Meal allowance Internal trainings including workshops and seminars Paid certifications and technical as well as soft-skills training Possibility to participate in international conferences Fresh fruit, coffee, and a weekly company breakfast in the office Loyalty bonus after 5, 10, 15 and more years with the company Referral bonus programme Corporate events including team building, outdoor activities, Christmas party, health week, summer ice cream, and more Hybrid and remote working options available across our Czech offices in Prague, Hradec Králové, and Zlín About Us At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. With delivery centers in Prague, Hradec Králové, and Zlín, our Czech team delivers end-to-end solutions across industries. Here, innovation thrives through collaboration, and every idea drives our partners' success. Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum! Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

review_candidates.company: CMCC Foundation - Centro Euro Mediterraneo sui Cambiamenti Climatici
review_candidates.description: CMCC Position cod. 12854 Full-Stack Web Developer Deadline: December 2nd, 2026 What We Are Looking For Do you build web applications end to end — from a React interface with complex, validated forms to the Node.js services and MongoDB collections behind it — and then take care of getting them online, on a Linux server behind Nginx, with a proper domain and HTTPS certificate? Are you as comfortable fixing a failing CI pipeline as you are sitting down with a colleague to understand what is really behind the bug they reported? We are looking for a Full-Stack Web Developer to join the CMCC Foundation and to design, develop, deploy and maintain the web applications that support the Foundation’s internal processes and services. The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience with the modern JavaScript ecosystem — React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js and MongoDB on the back end — and is at ease with Linux, Git, CI/CD pipelines and the day-to-day work of keeping applications published and running. What matters most to us is what you have actually built and shipped: we value demonstrable professional experience over formal qualifications. Whether it is implementing a new feature requested by an internal office, modelling data so that concurrent writes do not step on each other, configuring DNS records and a reverse proxy to bring a new application online, or isolating the root cause of a problem reported by a user and turning it into a clean fix, your contribution will be key to the quality and reliability of CMCC’s digital services. We are looking for an autonomous, careful and reliable professional, with attention to data quality, a good command of English, and the ability to listen to users and translate their needs into working software. About Us CMCC Foundation is a cross-cutting scientific research center on climate change and its interactions with the environment, society, the world of business, and policymakers. Our work aims to stimulate sustainable growth, protect the environment, and develop strategies for the adaptation and mitigation of climate change. CMCC's core objective is to conduct cutting-edge science, to train the next generation of scientists at both national and international levels, and to be a beacon for climate modelling. CMCC pursues fundamental and applied science with utmost scientific integrity, prioritizing data-driven science and providing data, information, and research results that can support informed public debate and decision-making processes. To achieve climate research objectives at the highest international standards, we invest in training all our talents, and strive to create a workplace where everyone can excel. At CMCC you will find a strong, professional environment. Join an inclusive community that values diversity, where every voice is heard and respected. Help foster a culture of innovation and societal change, where individuals from all backgrounds can thrive and succeed. Over the last decade, CMCC has experienced extraordinary growth. We are now embarking on a new chapter of our journey that will further boost CMCC’s global position in climate change research…Together! To learn more about this opportunity and submit your application, please refer to the following: ROLE The Full-Stack Web Developer reports to the Head of the IT and is responsible for the development, deployment and maintenance of the Foundation’s web applications across the whole stack: front-end interfaces, back-end services, database and the infrastructure needed to publish and run them. He/she works in close contact with the internal users of the applications — administrative offices, research divisions and management — analysing their requests, isolating problems and translating needs into solutions, with autonomy and attention to data quality. Given the cross-cutting nature of the Office, the Full-Stack Web Developer is also involved in the integration of the Foundation’s applications with management/ERP systems and automation platforms, and in the progressive adoption of good engineering practices — automated testing, application security, AI-assisted development — within the team. Responsibilities The Full-Stack Web Developer will be responsible for: Designing and developing front-end interfaces with modern React (hooks, Context) and Next.js — preferably App Router, Server Components and Server Actions — including complex forms with validation and handling of unsaved changes Developing back-end services in Node.js with modern JavaScript (ES2020+), exposing and consuming REST APIs Modelling documents and collections in MongoDB, designing aggregation pipelines and indexes, and handling concurrent writes on the same data Managing source code in Git with a multi-branch workflow, building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) with deployment on Linux servers (PM2) Publishing web applications and test environments: configuring domains and subdomains (DNS A, CNAME and TXT records, TTL), reverse proxy with Nginx and HTTPS certificates (e.g. Let’s Encrypt) Configuring and using AWS services (EC2, Lambda, Cognito) and implementing authentication and authorisation flows based on OAuth2 / OpenID Connect Analysing requests and issue reports from internal users, isolating the root cause of problems and translating needs into solutions, with autonomy and attention to data quality Integrating the Foundation’s applications with management/ERP systems (e.g. SAP) and automation platforms (e.g. Make, n8n, Zapier) via REST APIs and webhooks Contributing to the operational management of the MongoDB instance — backup and restore, monitoring — and to the quality of the code base through automated tests on the application logic Applying application security best practices (OWASP Top 10), with particular attention to server-side access control and injection prevention Using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) in day-to-day work, critically reviewing their output Requirements Demonstrable professional experience is the main selection criterion for this position. Candidates are invited to describe concretely, in their CV and/or cover letter, the applications they have built, the stack and infrastructure they have worked with and their role in each project; links to public repositories or portfolios are welcome. A university degree is not required and will be considered a preferential qualification. At least 1 years of professional experience in the development of web applications across the whole stack (front end, back end, database and deployment), gained in companies, research organisations, public bodies or as a freelancer Solid experience with modern React (hooks, Context, complex forms with validation and handling of unsaved changes) and Next.js, preferably with App Router, Server Components and Server Actions Very good knowledge of modern JavaScript (ES2020+) and of server-side development with Node.js Experience with MongoDB: document modelling, aggregation pipelines, indexes and handling of concurrent writes on the same data Use of Linux from the command line, Git in a multi-branch workflow, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and deployment on servers (PM2) Experience in publishing web applications: configuration of domains and subdomains (DNS A, CNAME and TXT records, TTL), reverse proxy with Nginx and HTTPS certificates (e.g. Let’s Encrypt), to make applications and test environments reachable online Basic knowledge of AWS (EC2, Lambda, Cognito) and of the OAuth2 / OpenID Connect protocols Ability to analyse issue reports from internal users, isolate the cause of a problem and translate needs into solutions, with autonomy and attention to data quality Use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), with the ability to critically review their output Good knowledge of Italian and English, written and spoken, in order to interact with internal users and to work with technical documentation The following will be considered preferential qualifications: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related subjects Integration between systems via REST APIs and webhooks, with management/ERP systems (e.g. SAP) and automation platforms (e.g. Make, n8n, Zapier) MongoDB administration: backup and restore, monitoring and operational management of an instance Writing automated unit tests on the application logic Practical knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, in particular server-side access control and injection prevention Duration, Compensation & Benefits Please note that this opportunity possibility of renewal The National Collective Labour Agreement for the Tertiary, Distribution and Services Sector (Confcommercio) shall apply to the contract The gross annual salary range for this position is 25,000–35,000 Euros. The salary offered within the range will be determined based on years of relevant experience, level of seniority, specific technical skills, applying objective and gender-neutral criteria Welfare package of 2,000 Euro per year Flexible working time as per internal policies Support during the immigration process, if needed PROTECTED CATEGORY Belonging to legally protected categories (ex L. 68/99) will constitute a preferential condition.
